tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, fields, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table headers, grouped filters.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and placeholders on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. Never on brand or band fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and inside cards. Never the only edge of a control; use border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of fields and ghost buttons. 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, links, active states. Text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-soft; large brand blocks on the cover.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Chip and badge fill, selected row, icon tile background. Text on it is brand-strong.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Full-width hero and call-to-action bands, image placeholders. Text on it is on-band.

tokens.name: band-alt
tokens.usage: Second band tone for stacked angled sections. Text on it is on-band.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Headings and body on band and band-alt.

tokens.name: on-band-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on band and band-alt.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Sand-gold highlight: price emphasis, awaiting-deposit status, moon and star shapes. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed state: outline and text on surface-raised, always with a check icon and the word.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a solid success fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Declined state and field errors on surface-raised, always with an x icon and the word.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a solid danger fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px to 3px offset, on every surface.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim over a camp photo so on-band text stays readable; check the photo.

families.display: "Readex Pro", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

tokens.name: radius-sm

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, textareas.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels and modal sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards and tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover state of cards and buttons.
